v2-register-icons.description: 2.0 registers icons per glyph. Opt an existing app into the full glyph set (provideSvIcons(svAllIcons)) so every name it draws keeps rendering; trim it to the glyphs you use afterwards.

v2-pie-family.description: 2.0 has one pie family: sv-default-pie-chart becomes sv-pie-chart, sv-default-pie-chart-pro becomes sv-pie-chart-pro, and sv-donut-chart becomes sv-pie-chart-pro variant="donut" (with its 1.x size kept). Renames the elements, the classes and the option and slice types.

v2-data-table-responsive.description: 2.0 names what the data table does on a phone with one input: [cardOnMobile]="true" becomes responsive="cards". sv-record-grid became responsive="records" on the table; files that use it are listed for you to fold by hand.
